assetType: six-view photo atlas for selected product; not ideation

prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create a precise six-view product visualisation of the SAME MOVERNO sneaker shown in the input image. This is a product detail asset, not a redesign, not six alternatives. Image 1 is the exact design master; image 2 is the exact approved upright gate emblem geometry only. Use the master photo as the source of truth for shape, every panel, lace type and count, collar, material colors, pattern placement, heel details, sole and toe. Preserve black/ivory balance and any silver or antique-gold accents already in the master. Do not introduce new accents. Do not add graphics or words.
Output 2048x1536 landscape. Exactly 6 clean orthographic product photos in an evenly spaced 3-column by 2-row grid. Pure warm-white seamless background everywhere, discreet shadows, professional e-commerce photography. No typography, no labels, no boxes, no watermarks, no props, no separate floating logo.
GRID: top left = OUTER lateral profile, heel left/toe right, matching the visible side of the master; top middle = INNER medial profile, heel right/toe left; top right = straight FRONT toe-facing view; bottom left = straight REAR heel-facing view; bottom middle = straight overhead TOP view, toe up; bottom right = outsole BOTTOM view, toe up. Each panel contains ONE COMPLETE shoe fully inside its cell, centered, with generous clean margins. All six are consistent views of the same left shoe, never pairs. Front/back/top views must be truly straight, not a 3/4 view. Grid cell boundaries at x=0, 683, 1365, 2048 and y=0, 768,1536. Product stays at least 55px away from cell edges.
RETAIN: exact forefoot width and toe cap/rand shape, sole thickness and sidewall line/rib layout, shaft height, shoe opening, collar lining color, eyelet and lacing count, stitching paths, all visible motif crops and regular gate emblem. The gate has two independent upright opposing curved blades and an open central slit, never a butterfly or improvised icon. Patterned panels continue around the same physical panels across perspectives; don't invent new pattern-covered regions. Keep the medial side coherent with master construction. Unseen rear/outsole are provisional visual continuations: use restrained family-appropriate construction with matching existing materials and visible outsole-edge color, simple standard rubber grip texture and no new proprietary sculpture or branded marks. The bottom view is a concept, not measured factory documentation. Preserve the current sole SIDEWALL even while inferring its underside.
Keep lighting neutral enough to distinguish leather grain, canvas weave, suede and metallic finish. No distressed effects unless already present. Avoid inconsistent motifs, changing shoe identity, collages of different shoes, duplicate viewpoints, clipped toes, mirrored lettering, additional buckles, newly invented mesh, extra logos.
Specific master: 幕隙经典高帮. Important visible features to lock: 踝侧门徽; 后帮暗纹; 骨灰包边. Product remains exactly the reference design, simply viewed from six directions.
